'''Stobar''' was a dark and shadowy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Boeus sector/Legends|Boeus sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], and was known for being a very violent planet, for its many criminals.

==History==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] was seen choking a [[Sassi/Legends|waitress]] at [[Plop Dribble's/Legends|Plop Dribble's]], a spaceport restaurant, while searching for his brother, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. The authorities were alerted, but he escaped onboard a ship and ordered [[Unidentified Sakiyan cargo hauler/Legends|the pilot]] to [[Lotho Minor/Legends|Lotho Minor]].
